text.A file on this Mac: drop it on your comp: A file on this Mac: drop it on your companion and say “play this on the TV”, or say “play ~/Movies/film.mp4 on the TV”. Subtitles: an .srt or .vtt file beside it.
text.An https link to the video file or strea: An https link to the video file or stream itself, not a web page. The TV plays the original.
text.Areas are left, right, top, bottom or ce: Areas are left, right, top, bottom or center.
text.Can't look for TVs on this network: {err: Can't look for TVs on this network: {error}. Allow Sidefolk in Privacy & Security › Local Network.
text.Change the picture or sound below while: Change the picture or sound below while you watch.
text.Changes while you share: the TV shows th: Changes while you share: the TV shows the new picture in a moment.
Check {tv} shows the same six digits.
Choose Allow on {tv} with its remote.
Choose Mac only, TV only, or Mac and TV.
Choose a window to share first.
text.Compare the code {code} with the one on: Compare the code {code} with the one on {tv}. If they match, choose Codes match · Pair on Miraya's page in Home; then Allow on the TV.
text.Couldn't open that video. Choose the fil: Couldn't open that video. Choose the file or HTTPS address again.
Couldn't prepare the video for the TV.
text.Couldn't reach the TV: {error}. Check th: Couldn't reach the TV: {error}. Check that Miraya is open on it and both are on the same network.
Couldn't start the Wi-Fi video engine.
text.Direct and encrypted, on your network: Direct and encrypted, on your network
text.Forget this TV here, then pair again wit: Forget this TV here, then pair again with the code on the TV.
text.Forget this TV on this Mac; pairing agai: Forget this TV on this Mac; pairing again needs a new code.
text.Forgot {tv}. Pairing again needs a new c: Forgot {tv}. Pairing again needs a new code.
text.Getting the TV and a direct video connec: Getting the TV and a direct video connection ready.
text.Handy for one app beside another, or a v: Handy for one app beside another, or a video playing in the middle.
text.Make sure these six digits match the one: Make sure these six digits match the ones on the TV. If they don't, cancel: something else may be answering for your TV.
text.Miraya is already busy with {tv}. Stop i: Miraya is already busy with {tv}. Stop it first.
Miraya is busy with {tv}. Stop it first.
Miraya is waiting for the TV's remote.
text.Miraya isn't running. Turn it on in Sett: Miraya isn't running. Turn it on in Settings › Extensions, then try again.
Miraya's volume on the TV is {percent}.
text.No TV called “{tv}” is on. These are aro: No TV called “{tv}” is on. These are around:
text.No TV is waiting for its code to be conf: No TV is waiting for its code to be confirmed.
text.No TV running Miraya is on this network: No TV running Miraya is on this network right now. Open Miraya on the TV; or pair by the address it shows.
No TV running Miraya is on this network. Open Miraya on the TV, or pair by the address it shows.
text.No bigger than the TV's own size: No bigger than the TV's own size
text.No open window matches “{window}”. Open: No open window matches “{window}”. Open it, or choose one on Miraya's page.
No window to share is open.
Nothing is on the TV from this Mac.
Nothing is playing on the TV.
text.Now choose Allow on the TV with its remo: Now choose Allow on the TV with its remote.
text.Off: smoother motion, softer picture whe: Off: smoother motion, softer picture when the network is busy.
text.Only this window goes to the TV, even wh: Only this window goes to the TV, even while you use other apps. Its app's sound goes too.
Open Miraya on the TV first.
Open Miraya on the TV to share to it.
Open Miraya on the TV, then share.
text.Open Miraya on your Android TV, on the s: Open Miraya on your Android TV, on the same network as this Mac.
Open Miraya on your Android TV, on the same network as this Mac. It shows up here by its room name.
text.Pairing timed out. Try again and compare: Pairing timed out. Try again and compare the new six-digit code.
text.Paused. Nothing new reaches the TV until: Paused. Nothing new reaches the TV until you resume.
text.Pictures of your screens show here once: Pictures of your screens show here once macOS lets Sidefolk record the screen: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording. Sharing the first time asks.
text.Play a video on the TV: Play a video on the TV
text.Saves the network when the TV's app show: Saves the network when the TV's app shows less than 1080p.
Say which file or HTTPS link to play.
text.Share a display, a window or an area?: Share a display, a window or an area?
text.Sidefolk couldn't change the Mac's sound: Sidefolk couldn't change the Mac's sound output.
text.Sidefolk didn't confirm the Mac's sound: Sidefolk didn't confirm the Mac's sound output. Miraya selected Mac and TV; check the Mac's mute control.
Stop first to change the TV.
Stop sharing to that TV first.
Subtitles must be an .srt or .vtt file.
text.System audio only; the microphone is nev: System audio only; the microphone is never shared. TV only temporarily mutes this Mac's entire output, including other apps.
That isn't an https:// link to a video. Links to web pages (YouTube, Netflix) don't work: the TV needs the video file or stream itself.
text.That screen or window isn't available an: That screen or window isn't available any more. Choose another and share again.
text.The Mac's sound couldn't be captured: {e: The Mac's sound couldn't be captured: {error}. Try sharing without sound.
text.The TV and this Mac couldn't agree on th: The TV and this Mac couldn't agree on the video. Update Miraya on the TV.
text.The TV answered in a way this version do: The TV answered in a way this version doesn't know. Update Miraya on the TV.
text.The TV asked to pair at an unexpected ti: The TV asked to pair at an unexpected time. Update Miraya on the TV.
text.The TV closed the connection. Make sure: The TV closed the connection. Make sure Miraya is still open on the TV.
text.The TV connected but hasn't shown a pict: The TV connected but hasn't shown a picture. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
text.The TV couldn't open a direct video conn: The TV couldn't open a direct video connection. Check the local network permission, any VPN, and Wi-Fi client isolation.
text.The TV didn't answer. Check its address: The TV didn't answer. Check its address and that both are on the same network.
text.The TV didn't get ready in time. Trying: The TV didn't get ready in time. Trying again…
text.The TV didn't start playing within {seco: The TV didn't start playing within {seconds} seconds. Check the video's format and address.
The TV is opening the video.
text.The TV may keep showing the last picture: The TV may keep showing the last picture. Nothing new reaches it until you resume.
text.The TV plays the original file; nothing: The TV plays the original file; nothing is recorded.
text.The TV repeated its greeting. Update Mir: The TV repeated its greeting. Update Miraya on the TV.
text.The TV sent something this version doesn: The TV sent something this version doesn't know. Update Miraya on the TV.
text.The TV sent video settings at an unexpec: The TV sent video settings at an unexpected time.
text.The TV started a different video session: The TV started a different video session.
text.The TV stopped answering. Check that it': The TV stopped answering. Check that it's on and connected.
text.The TV stopped showing the video. Reconn: The TV stopped showing the video. Reconnecting…
text.The TV's identity didn't match. If the T: The TV's identity didn't match. If the TV was reset, forget it here and pair again.
text.The connection to the TV ended: {error}: The connection to the TV ended: {error}
text.The first time, you compare a six-digit: The first time, you compare a six-digit code with the TV.
text.The most the TV gets; the TV's own size: The most the TV gets; the TV's own size can lower it.
text.The pairing codes don't match. Nothing w: The pairing codes don't match. Nothing was shared.
The saved TV credentials are incomplete. Forget this TV and pair again.
text.The saved TV identity is invalid. Forget: The saved TV identity is invalid. Forget this TV and pair again.
text.The video connection didn't come back. C: The video connection didn't come back. Check the TV and the network.
text.The video connection failed. Check the T: The video connection failed. Check the TV and the network.
text.The video connection took too long to st: The video connection took too long to start. Try sharing again.
text.This TV runs a Miraya this extension can: This TV runs a Miraya this extension can't talk to.
text.This TV's identity changed. Forget it he: This TV's identity changed. Forget it here and compare a new code.
This video can't jump ahead or back.
text.To list the windows, macOS needs to let: To list the windows, macOS needs to let Sidefolk record the screen (Miraya runs inside Sidefolk).
Type the address Miraya shows on the TV.
text.Update Miraya on the TV to play videos o: Update Miraya on the TV to play videos on it.
text.Update Miraya on the TV: this extension: Update Miraya on the TV: this extension streams with its newer WebRTC engine.
text.Use the TV's remote. Next time this Mac: Use the TV's remote. Next time this Mac connects without a code.
text.macOS hasn't allowed Sidefolk to record: macOS hasn't allowed Sidefolk to record the screen yet, so windows can't be listed. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording.
macOS hasn't allowed Sidefolk to record the screen yet. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, then try again.

macOS hasn't allowed Sidefolk to record the screen. Turn on Sidefolk in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, then share again. (Miraya runs inside Sidefolk, so the permission is Sidefolk's.)
text.{file} is on another disk. Copy it to yo: {file} is on another disk. Copy it to your Mac's own disk first: Sidefolk lends Miraya a copy-on-write copy, which only works on the same disk.
{file} isn't a file Miraya can read.
text.{file} isn't a video or audio file the T: {file} isn't a video or audio file the TV can play.
text.{tv} is on: say “mirror my screen” to sh: {tv} is on: say “mirror my screen” to share.
{tv} isn't on now. Open Miraya on it.
